title: New Bark Town
hook: First 16-beat period of the New Bark Town lead (wave channel): D E pickup, F# A G F# E G F# D | A G A B D E D C# D E F# E

evidence.summary: Recipe-owned decode of pret/pokecrystal 3c813b0 audio/music/newbarktown.asm Music_NewBarkTown_Ch3 (tempo 187, about 102.21 BPM; wave channel one octave below the pulse register). Events 0-21 compared with Nayuki GSC New Bark Town track 2 (Channel 3) events 0-21: all 22 pitches (same octave) and attacks agree exactly. The decode and Nayuki share the game data (two independent decoders). Lead channel chosen from the data: channel 3 carries the sung theme, channel 1 the D-A-D arpeggio accompaniment, channel 2 the bass.

title: Lake
hook: The Lake theme tune (Lake Verity / Valor / Acuity): G G# A F# D | A D B F# F D A A# | A# A G A# A (held) | B A G B A F# D | A D B G E F# G | F# C# E D E F, one complete statement

evidence.summary: pret/pokeplatinum 62bdaac res/sound/SEQ/SEQ_D_LAKE.mid (the game's own sequence, 96 BPM), vibraphone track 22 events 0-37, explicit voice. Compared event by event with the Hooktheory "Lake - Pokemon Diamond and Pokemon Pearl" chorus section (single key D major, 96 BPM, a user transcription): 37 of 38 events pair exactly (octave convention +12), the A5 grace is absent in Hooktheory and the A#5 after it is 0.125 beat earlier. Strings track 18 plays the same tune earlier. The primary is the Platinum sequence; Diamond/Pearl use the same tune (the Hooktheory D/P transcription agrees), but no D/P ROM data was checked.

title: Dragonborn
hook: The Skyrim main theme melody: the D-C#-D figure, the step up to E and back, then the B-B-A-B figure, closing on a held B (the line repeated once with the D-D-E-F# variant)

Reference: Kyle Landry "Skyrim - Main Theme [Piano Tutorial] (Synthesia)" (YouTube MUMJK0WBNOI, 1080p30, video SHA-256 6c02d694bc539c11fe0bccfc5fd128051357ca32bdacd607982b470a941a8d2a, 0-100 s read with roll2.py, roll SHA-256 1b2bd7aa52b54fc8738f5ba9f18fc331e6a743c054debb3a047ed6f7bb4186c7): the melody is doubled in two octaves; the upper copy (labels 9) is read, 48 explicit lines, one 60-semitone label shift, one linear time scale (0.5523 s per beat).
